thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-1763009999 for service hosted-inference-01. Symptom: sustained 5xx rate > 12% for 3m. Urgency: high. Escalation policy: production-critical. https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-1763009999
ryan: Acked. I'm on it.
:dana: pinging infra to check GPU node health, also checking autoscaler logs.
ben: looking at node metrics now. seeing high queue depth on pool-gpu-1, a few OOM kills? investigating.
charlie: support seeing 20+ customer errors reported in the last 10m, adding to status page.
alice: estimating customer impact — some hosted inference requests returning 502/503 intermittently. Can we throttle non-critical background jobs?
ryan: Good call. Initiating a quick mitigation: add nginx rate-limit for non-auth traffic and scale up dedicated pool.
incident-bot: Alert update: alert still firing. Escalation timer at 12m. Next step: notify secondary.
maria: I'm up, on manager standby. What do you need?
ryan: If secondary doesn't pick up within 10m we'll request manager bridge. For now trying restart of failing pod set and increasing pool capacity.
ben: Restarted inference-deployment v3 (rolling restart) on nodes node-23/24. Patch: turned down batch sizes to reduce memory pressure: GOMAXBATCH=8 -> 6.
:dana: autoscaler accepted extra instances, two extra GPUs provisioning in us-west-2; might take ~90s.
charlie: support: sent a message to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated error rates and routing around impacted capacity."
ryan: quick check of logs: repeated stack trace fragment: `kv cache OOM at kv_cache.cc:412` across a small subset of requests. Possible memory leak in model adapter after long-running sessions.
ben: can confirm OOMs on node-23 around 03:12:07 UTC. Core dump present, collecting.
incident-bot: Secondary on-call (dana) acknowledged at 1763010300.
dana: I see the core dumps. Will attach to debug thread after we stabilize. For now, scaling and rolling restart should mitigate.
ryan: Rolling restarts complete. New pods report healthy. Error rate dropping from 14% -> 4% in last 2m.
alice: Please hold on customer comms: marking as "partial degradation" on status page.
charlie: Updated status page and pasted workaround to helpdesk.
maria: Thanks team. Given that secondary acked late, I'll stay on call for 30m in case of re-escalation. Also request a follow-up RCA for the kv cache leak.
ryan: Agreed. Postmortem action items: 1) Add guard for kv cache allocations, 2) add early OOM alert per-host, 3) extend autoscaler warm pool in us-west-2. I'll create the ticket.
ben: uploading core dumps to /opt/sre/artifacts/PD-1763009999/ for research.
dana: I'll take lead on the memory fix and pair with research team.
charlie: Customers are seeing improvement, only a few residual errors. Continuing to monitor.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by auto-recovery and scaling at 1763010780. Incident status set to "monitoring".
ryan: Closing the immediate firefight. If error rate rises above 5% again, we'll re-escalate.
maria: Thanks for the quick mitigation. Please ping me once RCA draft is up.
alice: Noted, prepping customer follow-up email but holding until RCA draft.
ryan: Will follow up with timeline + mitigation notes in incident ticket. :thumbsup:
__notes: This thread simulates a concise oncall coordination flow for a PagerDuty escalation: alert -> ack -> scale/restart -> manager standby due to delayed secondary ack -> recovery and action items. Messages are short and Slack-like as required by agents.md.
